scripts.build: go build -trimpath -o bin/ingest ./cmd/ingest && go build -trimpath -o bin/worker ./cmd/worker
scripts.worker-parity:go: go build -trimpath -o bin/worker ./cmd/worker && dotenv -e ../../.env -- bun parity/worker-diff.ts --a ts --b go --go-bin bin/worker
scripts.worker-parity:full: go build -trimpath -o bin/worker ./cmd/worker && dotenv -e ../../.env -- bun parity/worker-diff.ts --a ts --b go --full --go-bin bin/worker
scripts.parity: go build -o bin/ingest ./cmd/ingest && dotenv -e ../../.env -- bun parity/diff.ts
